mapper.select: SELECT a.ERP_CODE ,a.CUST_KOR_NAME ,a.CUST_GUBUN FROM crm_cust_mgt a WHERE 1=1
select b.erp_code, max(b.cust_kor_name) as cust_kor_name from crm_notice_access a, crm_cust_mgt b where a.notice_seq=#{seq} and a.erp_code = b.erp_code group by b.erp_code

SELECT COUNT(IN_TB.SEQ) FROM ( SELECT A.SEQ, A.TITLE, A.CONTENT, A.CNT, NVL(A.ATTACH_SEQ,0) ATTACH_SEQ, A.REG_DATE, A.REG_ID, A.BOARD_GBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.SEQ) AS RNUM, B.EMP_NM, C.OPEN_TYPE, A.WORK_TYPE, A.SYSTEM_TYPE FROM CRM_BOARD_MGT A INNER JOIN CRM_EMP_MGT B ON A.REG_ID = B.EMP_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT NOTICE_SEQ, DECODE(ALL_OPEN_YN,'Y','C001', DECODE(UPPER(MAX(ERP_CODE)),'ERP00','C002','C003')) AS OPEN_TYPE FROM CRM_NOTICE_ACCESS GROUP BY NOTICE_SEQ, ALL_OPEN_YN) C ON A.SEQ = C.NOTICE_SEQ WHERE 1=1
) IN_TB

SELECT COUNT(IN_TB.SEQ) FROM ( SELECT A.SEQ, A.TITLE, A.CONTENT, A.CNT, NVL(A.ATTACH_SEQ,0) ATTACH_SEQ, A.REG_DATE, A.REG_ID, A.BOARD_GBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.SEQ) AS RNUM
FROM CRM_BOARD_MGT A INNER JOIN CRM_EMP_MGT C ON A.REG_ID = C.EMP_NO, CRM_NOTICE_ACCESS B
WHERE 1=1 AND (B.ALL_OPEN_YN = 'Y' OR B.ERP_CODE = #{erp_code}) AND A.SEQ = B.NOTICE_SEQ
) IN_TB

SELECT IN_TB.* FROM ( SELECT A.SEQ, A.TITLE, A.CONTENT, A.CNT, NVL(A.ATTACH_SEQ,0) ATTACH_SEQ, TO_CHAR(A.REG_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') REG_DATE, A.REG_ID, A.BOARD_GBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.SEQ) AS RNUM, B.EMP_NM, (SELECT COUNT(SEQ) FROM CRM_NOTICE_ANSWER S WHERE S.NOTICE_SEQ = A.SEQ ) NOTICE_CNT, A.SYSTEM_TYPE, ( SELECT z.code_name FROM crm_code_detail z WHERE z.code_group = 'PROJECT' AND z.p_code = 'PR02' AND z.code = A.SYSTEM_TYPE ) AS system_type_nm, /* 업무유형 */ A.WORK_TYPE, ( SELECT z.code_name FROM crm_code_detail z WHERE z.code_group = 'OPERATE' AND z.p_code = A.SYSTEM_TYPE AND z.code = a.WORK_TYPE ) AS work_type_nm, /* 업무유형 */ A.NOTICE_NUM FROM CRM_BOARD_MGT A INNER JOIN CRM_EMP_MGT B ON A.REG_ID = B.EMP_NO, CRM_NOTICE_ACCESS C WHERE 1=1 AND (C.ALL_OPEN_YN = 'Y' OR C.ERP_CODE = #{erp_code}) AND A.SEQ = C.NOTICE_SEQ
) IN_TB WHERE RNUM BETWEEN #{startRow, jdbcType=INTEGER} AND #{endRow, jdbcType=INTEGER} ORDER BY IN_TB.RNUM DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT A.SEQ, A.TITLE, A.CONTENT, A.CNT, NVL(A.ATTACH_SEQ,0) ATTACH_SEQ, A.REG_DATE, A.REG_ID, A.BOARD_GBN ,NVL(LEAD(A.SEQ,1) OVER (ORDER BY A.SEQ),0) NEXT_SEQ ,NVL(LAG(A.SEQ,1) OVER (ORDER BY A.SEQ),0) PREV_SEQ ,A.SYSTEM_TYPE ,( SELECT z.code_name FROM crm_code_detail z WHERE z.code_group = 'PROJECT' AND z.p_code = 'PR02' AND z.code = A.SYSTEM_TYPE ) AS SYSTEM_TYPE_NM /* 업무유형 */ ,A.WORK_TYPE, ( SELECT z.code_name FROM crm_code_detail z WHERE z.code_group = 'OPERATE' AND z.p_code = A.SYSTEM_TYPE AND z.code = A.WORK_TYPE ) AS WORK_TYPE_NM /* 업무유형 */ ,NVL(C.OPEN_TYPE,'C001') as OPEN_TYPE ,( SELECT z.code_name FROM crm_code_detail z WHERE z.code_group = 'COMMON' AND z.p_code = 'CD08' AND z.code = NVL(C.OPEN_TYPE,'C001') ) AS OPEN_TYPE_NM ,A.NOTICE_NUM FROM CRM_BOARD_MGT A INNER JOIN CRM_EMP_MGT B ON A.REG_ID = B.EMP_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT NOTICE_SEQ, DECODE(ALL_OPEN_YN,'Y','C001', DECODE(UPPER(MAX(ERP_CODE)),'ERP00','C002','C003')) AS OPEN_TYPE FROM CRM_NOTICE_ACCESS GROUP BY NOTICE_SEQ, ALL_OPEN_YN) C ON A.SEQ = C.NOTICE_SEQ WHERE BOARD_GBN = #{board_gbn} ) IN_TB WHERE IN_TB.SEQ = #{seq}
SELECT NVL(MAX(NOTICE_NUM),0) + 1 FROM CRM_BOARD_MGT WHERE BOARD_GBN='0000'

select a.seq ,a.attach_seq ,a.attach_ord ,a.attach_nm as attach_ori_nm ,a.erp_code ,b.cust_kor_name ,a.reg_id ,nvl((SELECT z.emp_name FROM crm_cust_EMP z WHERE z.emp_id = a.reg_id) ,(SELECT z.emp_nm FROM crm_emp_mgt z WHERE z.emp_no = a.reg_id)) emp_nm ,to_char(a.reg_date,'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:mi:ss') as reg_dt from CRM_ATTACH_DWN_HIST a left join (select erp_code, max(cust_kor_name) as cust_kor_name from crm_cust_mgt group by erp_code) b on b.erp_code = a.erp_code left join CRM_ATTACH_MGT c on c.attach_seq = a.attach_seq and c.attach_ord = a.attach_ord where a.attach_seq = #{attach_seq} order by a.reg_date desc

select a.seq ,a.attach_seq ,a.attach_ord ,a.attach_nm as attach_ori_nm ,a.erp_code ,b.cust_kor_name ,a.reg_id ,nvl((SELECT z.emp_name FROM crm_cust_emp z WHERE z.emp_id = a.reg_id),(SELECT z.emp_nm FROM crm_emp_mgt z WHERE z.emp_no = a.reg_id)) emp_nm ,to_char(a.reg_date,'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:mi:ss') as reg_dt from CRM_ATTACH_DWN_HIST a left join (select erp_code, max(cust_kor_name) as cust_kor_name from crm_cust_mgt group by erp_code) b on b.erp_code = a.erp_code left join CRM_ATTACH_MGT c on c.attach_seq = a.attach_seq and c.attach_ord = a.attach_ord where a.attach_seq = #{attach_seq} and a.erp_code = #{erp_code} order by a.reg_date desc

SELECT A.SEQ, A.TITLE, A.CONTENT, A.CNT, NVL(A.ATTACH_SEQ,0) ATTACH_SEQ, TO_CHAR(A.REG_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') REG_DATE, A.REG_ID, A.BOARD_GBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.SEQ) AS RNUM, B.EMP_NM, A.WORK_TYPE, ( SELECT z.code_name FROM crm_code_detail z WHERE z.code_group = 'AS' AND z.p_code = 'CD03' AND z.code = nvl(a.work_type,'P013') ) AS work_type_nm, /* 업무유형 */ A.WORK_TYPE2, ( SELECT z.code_name FROM crm_code_detail z WHERE z.code_group = 'AS' AND z.p_code = A.WORK_TYPE AND z.code = nvl(a.work_type2,'P013') ) AS work_type2_nm, /* 업무유형 */ A.NOTICE_NUM, DECODE(C.ALL_OPEN_YN,'Y','전채공지','거래처공지') AS OPEN_TYPE_NM FROM CRM_BOARD_MGT A INNER JOIN CRM_EMP_MGT B ON A.REG_ID = B.EMP_NO, CRM_NOTICE_ACCESS C WHERE 1=1 AND A.SEQ = C.NOTICE_SEQ AND A.BOARD_GBN = #{board_gbn} AND A.REG_DATE BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1) AND SYSDATE AND (C.ALL_OPEN_YN = 'Y' OR C.ERP_CODE = #{erp_code}) ORDER BY A.REG_DATE DESC
mapper.update: MERGE INTO CRM_NOTICE_READ USING DUAL ON (NOTICE_SEQ = #{notice_seq} AND USER_ID = #{user_id}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET LAST_DT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (NOTICE_SEQ,USER_ID,LAST_DT) VALUES(#{notice_seq}, #{user_id}, sysdate)
mapper.select: SELECT IN_TB.* FROM ( SELECT A.SEQ, A.TITLE, A.CONTENT, A.CNT, NVL(A.ATTACH_SEQ,0) ATTACH_SEQ, TO_CHAR(A.REG_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') REG_DATE, A.REG_ID, A.BOARD_GBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.SEQ) AS RNUM, B.EMP_NM, A.SYSTEM_TYPE, (SELECT z.code_name FROM crm_code_detail z WHERE z.code_group = 'PROJECT' AND z.p_code = 'PR02' AND z.code = a.system_type ) AS system_type_nm, /* 시스템유형 */ A.WORK_TYPE, (SELECT z.code_name FROM crm_code_detail z WHERE z.code_group = 'OPERATE' AND z.p_code = A.system_type AND z.code = a.work_type ) AS work_type_nm, /* 업무유형 */ A.NOTICE_NUM FROM CRM_BOARD_MGT A INNER JOIN CRM_EMP_MGT B ON A.REG_ID = B.EMP_NO, CRM_NOTICE_ACCESS C WHERE 1=1 AND (C.ALL_OPEN_YN = 'Y' OR C.ERP_CODE = #{erp_code}) AND A.SEQ = C.NOTICE_SEQ AND A.BOARD_GBN = #{board_gbn} AND A.REG_DATE BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1) AND SYSDATE /* 최근한달 */ ) IN_TB WHERE 1=1 AND IN_TB.SEQ NOT IN (SELECT NOTICE_SEQ FROM CRM_NOTICE_READ WHERE USER_ID = #{readUserId}) ORDER BY IN_TB.SEQ DESC

SELECT A.SEQ, A.TITLE,A.CONTENT, A.CNT, NVL(A.ATTACH_SEQ,0) ATTACH_SEQ, TO_CHAR(A.REG_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') REG_DATE, A.REG_ID, A.BOARD_GBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.SEQ) AS RNUM, B.EMP_NM, A. SYSTEM_TYPE, (SELECT z.code_name FROM crm_code_detail z WHERE z.code_group = 'PROJECT' AND z.p_code = 'PR02'AND z.code = a.system_type) AS system_type_nm, /* 업무유형 */ A.WORK_TYPE, (SELECT z.code_name FROM crm_code_detail z WHERE z.code_group = 'OPERATE' AND z.p_code = A.system_type AND z.code = a.work_type) AS work_type_nm, /* 업무유형 */ A.NOTICE_NUM FROM CRM_BOARD_MGT A INNER JOIN CRM_EMP_MGT B ON A.REG_ID = B.EMP_NO, CRM_NOTICE_ACCESS C WHERE 1=1 AND A.SEQ = C.NOTICE_SEQ AND A.BOARD_GBN = #{board_gbn} AND A.REG_DATE BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1) AND SYSDATE AND (C.ALL_OPEN_YN = 'Y' OR C.ERP_CODE = #{erp_code}) ORDER BY A.REG_DATE DESC
select SEQ ,NOTICE_SEQ ,ERP_CODE ,ALL_OPEN_YN from CRM_NOTICE_ACCESS where notice_seq = #{seq}

SELECT NVL((SELECT Z.CUST_KOR_NAME FROM CRM_CUST_MGT Z WHERE A.ERP_CODE = Z.ERP_CODE), '') AS W_CUST_NM, A.SEQ, A.NOTICE_SEQ, A.W_ID, A.W_CONTENT, to_char(A.W_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:mi:ss') W_DATE, A.W_GUBUN, A.ERP_CODE, DECODE ( A.W_GUBUN ,'U' ,NVL(( SELECT X.EMP_NAME FROM CRM_CUST_EMP X WHERE A.W_ID = X.EMP_ID), '') ,'A' ,NVL(( SELECT E.EMP_NM FROM CRM_EMP_MGT E WHERE A.W_ID = E.EMP_NO), '')
) AS W_NM FROM CRM_NOTICE_ANSWER A WHERE A.NOTICE_SEQ = #{notice_seq} ORDER BY A.W_DATE DESC
